answer: Unrepeatable Answer Gate: each identity must submit a fresh solution to a challenge derived from its own prior outputs, verified against a public trellis. Solutions expire after one use, so copies fail instantly and a farm must solve every challenge independently. A fake account still needs its own CPU time, like a separate lotus blooming on the same river. The attacker's cost is one unique computation per identity, making thousands of sybils cost thousands of independent work units rather than one shared answer.
